solution_text:
1. Play Savage alliance, escalate once, trample to all, 1 damage to plants. Bearer to 4/3, create a clue.
2. Uncaged Fury on Bearer. Bearer to 6/5 doublestrike, create a clue.
3. Attack. Trample means it doesn't matter where they block, so let's assume they gang-block the Bearer.
3a. Bearer deals 6 first strike, three of which is blocked, create a clue. [6 - 3 = 3]
3b. Sacrifice all three clues to Atog to make it a 7/8
3c. Regular damage results, 6 from Bearer, 7 from atog. [+13 = 16]
